context.passage:
International Culture Fest Volunteer Form
Name: Sunny Abdoo
Address: 484 Wyckoff Street, Rockville, Maryland 20847
E-mail address: sabdoo@trmail.com
Thank you for your interest in volunteering at the International Culture Fest in Rockville
on April 25. Sign up below for the activities you are interested in. All volunteers are
granted a free meal ticket to use at any of our food vendors after their shift is over. You
will receive confirmation of your shift assignment by April 1. Volunteers are required to
attend an orientation session on April 9 or April 10.
Shift roles:
Setup: Put up tents and concession stands
Parking attendants: Direct traffic and assist with parking
On-site ticket sales: Sell tickets at the ticket sales booth
Information crew: Direct attendees to their destinations. Distribute map and
performance schedule
Concession crew: Sell food and beverages
Cleanup: Help take down tents and concession stands
Shift times:
8:00 A.M.-12:00 P.M.
12:00 P.M.-4:00 P.M.
4:00 P.M.-8:00 P.M.
Additional comments: L am only available to attend the first orientation session.

choices: It offers volunteers a meal voucher.
